title: OpenAI adapter: preserve client-seed, robust stream fragment reassembly, and metadata tag passthrough
author: Maya Patel
description: This change updates the OpenAI compatibility adapter to support the latest Responses API variant semantics (responses/v21) and fixes several edge cases we saw in production around streaming reassembly, client-specified randomness hints, and metadata passthrough. Motivation: customers using mixed toolcall/streaming workloads saw corrupted interleaved chunks when a retry or connection hiccup caused fragments to arrive out-of-order; at the same time the new responses endpoint exposes a client_seed/rng_hint header and a top-level metadata map that must be preserved through our bridge to avoid breaking ordered sampling and downstream telemetry. Goals: 1) reliably preserve client-provided seed/rng_hint and advertise it through our internal tracing and rerunnable request token so deterministic behaviors are reproducible; 2) introduce per-stream fragment IDs and a small reassembly window to safely reorder/recombine chunked frames without harmful buffering latency; 3) ensure top-level metadata and user_tags are passed unchanged through the OpenAI adapter and surface in fulfillment logs and observability; 4) add schema-strict mode for structured-output use-cases to fail-fast on malformed JSON payloads instead of producing silent parsing errors. Summary of changes: core adapter: accept and forward X-OpenAI-Client-Seed / X-OpenAI-RNG-Hint headers into the responses envelope; wire seed into request trace and into the deterministic key used by the runtime caching layer. Streaming layer: attach fragment_id + sequence_index to each outbound chunk; accept incoming chunks that include those attributes and reassemble using a small out-of-order buffer with a 200ms adaptive timeout (configurable). Toolcalls and structured output: add an escape prefix for toolcall boundaries to prevent accidental merging when fragments split JSON boundaries; add a schema-strict flag that uses the JSON schema returned by the model to validate top-level structured responses and return a 422 to callers if strict validation fails. Observability & testing: add unit + integration coverage for reassembly, seed propagation, and metadata passthrough; new e2e playbook 'responses-v21-tear-up' simulates flaky connections and interleaved toolcalls. Backwards compatibility: adapter falls back to old behavior when fragment metadata is missing; client-seed is optional and will not affect existing RNG behavior unless provided. Risks / compatibility notes: small behavioral change when schema_strict=true could cause callers that previously tolerated malformed JSON to receive 422; marked label "breaking-change-candidate" for product review.
commits: 6 commits: initial adapter plumbing (headers + trace) -> streaming fragment framing -> reassembly buffer + timeout -> toolcall boundary escape -> schema-strict validation + tests -> integration playbook
changed_files: services/openai_adapter/adapter.go - added header parsing and envelope mapping
observability/events.go - metadata passthrough to fulfillment events
sdk/http_client.go - surfaced X-OpenAI-Client-Seed in outgoing requests
docs/api/openai_compat.md - documented new headers and schema_strict flag
review_comments: Omar Singh: This overall approach makes sense but we should avoid using a hard-coded 200ms window; can you expose an adaptive config breakpoint and document performance tradeoffs?
Maya Patel (author): Agree, made the timeout configurable via fragment_reassembly_timeout_ms and added a note in the docs about latency vs safety tradeoffs
Elena Ruiz: The toolcall escape prefix looks fragile if model output itself includes the sequence. Can we instead add an explicit toolcall marker field on chunk frames?
Maya Patel: Switched to an explicit chunk-level 'toolcall_marker' boolean on frames; fallback remains the textual escape for older bridges; added tests for both paths
Kai Nakamura: Unit tests look good. Integration run failed once due to a flakey CI network simulation; re-ran and passed. Approving after minor nits fixed.
Product-Manager (FYI): Marked as breaking-change-candidate; please surface to the release notes and notify SRE teams before rollout.
release_notes: Add OpenAI responses/v21 compatibility: preserve client seed and RNG hints, robust streaming fragment reassembly with configurable timeout, metadata/user_tags passthrough, and optional schema_strict validation for structured outputs. NOTE: schema_strict=true may cause 422 on malformed model JSON.
notes_for_release: Ops: rollout gate: enable fragment reassembly by default in staged regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1), notify SRE to watch fulfillment parsing error alerts and latency. SDK: bump HTTP client to include X-OpenAI-Client-Seed when caller sets deterministic sampling.
